in_marathi.name: Shubhdeep
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shubhdeep हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from Sanskrit, Shubh means 'auspicious' and Deep means 'depth'. The name signifies the blessed and profound nature of an individual. It is believed that the bearer of this name is blessed with great fortune and wisdom.
